description: MAIN-PARA's cold-start arm, derived from app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:107-109 together with RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN at :273-284 - transaction CB00 started at a cleared screen with no communication area behind it. THE PRECONDITION IS EIBCALEN = 0 AND IT IS DECLARED AS SUCH: eibcalen is 0 and commarea carries no member, which is how this harness represents an area that never travelled. It is deliberately not a populated area described as zero-length. :111 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA sits on the other side of the IF and never runs, so CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is read at its WORKING-STORAGE initial state and any member a client might have sent alongside a missing area would be fabricated evidence rather than input. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-105 run first on every arm: :101 SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE, :102 SET USR-MODIFIED-NO TO TRUE, and :104-105 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO - the first two restate the declared initial values of WS-ERR-FLG and WS-USR-MODIFIED at :43-50, and the third is the only map byte this arm ever writes. :107 finds EIBCALEN zero, so :108 MOVEs 'COSGN00C' to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and :109 PERFORMs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN. That paragraph then runs its four statements and transfers: :275-277 IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES substitutes 'COSGN00C', and HERE THAT GUARD IS A NO-OP - :108 has already named that exact target, so the field passes through untouched and the substitution does not fire. The guard is a real one, but it earns its keep on the DFHPF3 arm at :129-134, where a caller may have left CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM blank; nothing in this case exercises it. :278 MOVEs WS-TRANID into CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, which becomes 'CB00'. :279 MOVEs WS-PGMNAME into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, which becomes 'COBIL00C'. :280 MOVEs ZEROS into CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, so the context leaves as 0 - THE EXACT OPPOSITE OF case01, which reaches :113 SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE and leaves the same field at 1. Asserting the 0 is what proves the reset happened rather than the advance, and it is why the next screen paints itself instead of validating a map nobody typed into. :281-284 EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) ends the invocation, so the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) at :146-149 is never reached: the termination is XCTL and not RETURN_TRANSID, and the two are not interchangeable. GATE G40 - THE XCTL BECOMES A RESPONSE FIELD. :281-284 is the program's ONLY XCTL site, and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN reaches it from exactly two callers: this cold-start arm at :109, and the DFHPF3 arm at :135 that siblings case04 and case05 represent. THIS CASE IS THE COLD-START CALLER. The transfer projects onto nextProgram = 'COSGN00C', eight characters at the X(08) width app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares for CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, echoed from that same field of the stamped area so the payload and the commarea cannot disagree. The client reads it and issues the follow-up call itself: there is NO server-side forward, NO HTTP redirect, NO request dispatch and NO session affinity (gate G37, AAP rule R6). nextMapset and nextMap are ABSENT rather than blank, and that absence is itself the assertion - they report the MAPSET and MAP operands of the SEND at :296-297, and this arm does not send. Naming COBIL00 and COBIL0A here would tell the client to paint the bill-payment screen on its way out of the bill-payment screen. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN, AND WHY BOTH LISTS ARE EMPTY. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN at :289-301 is not performed on this arm, and it is the ONLY caller of POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :319-338 - so no header is built, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at :321 is never evaluated, and not one of TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO, CURTIMEO, ACTIDINO, CURBALO, CONFIRMO or ERRMSGO is carried on a send. The sends list is therefore empty, and THIS IS THE ONLY CASE IN THIS DIRECTORY THAT SENDS NO SCREEN AT ALL: every other arm of the program reaches one of its nineteen SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN performs. expectedMessages is empty for a second and independent reason - COBIL00C has no DISPLAY anywhere on this path, so nothing reaches a message channel, and there is no send to carry a screen line onto one either. An entry in either list would not make this case more complete; it would make it wrong. cursorField is absent for the same reason: the cursor is positioned by :115 MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI, which is on the first-entry arm. NO DATASET IS TOUCHED. READ-CXACAIX-FILE, READ-ACCTDAT-FILE, UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE and WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE are each reached only from PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, which this arm never performs, so inputs, expectedWrites, expectedFinalState and expectedDatasets are empty BY DERIVATION and not by omission - seeding a row here would assert a read the COBOL does not make. An empty expectedWrites is the positive assertion that nothing was written. normalisations is empty because no fixture is seeded, so the cardxref 36-to-50 FILLER pad has nothing to apply to. THERE IS NO MONETARY FIELD ON THIS PATH: the program's single COMPUTE at :234 and the MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO TRAN-AMT at :224 both sit inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, so no BigDecimal, no scale and no RoundingMode.DOWN is asserted here - stated rather than left as a silent absence, because the truncating arithmetic of COBIL00C belongs to the cases that reach :211-235. expectedReturnCode is 0: there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in the program's 572 lines and RETURN-CODE is never assigned, so a normal completion is the only value it can produce. STATELESSNESS AND THE 160 BYTES. CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is 160 bytes, summed mechanically from app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy: CDEMO-GENERAL-INFO 4+8+4+8+8+1+1 = 34, CDEMO-CUSTOMER-INFO 9+25+25+25 = 84, CDEMO-ACCOUNT-INFO 11+1 = 12, CDEMO-CARD-INFO 16, CDEMO-MORE-INFO 7+7 = 14. All sixteen carriers travel back in the payload, and the four this arm stamps are pinned at their declared widths: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID X(04) 'CB00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM X(08) 'COBIL00C', CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM X(08) 'COSGN00C' and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 9(01) 0. THE OTHER TWELVE ARE NOT SILENTLY ZEROED - they are pinned at the initial values the area still holds precisely because :111 never ran: CDEMO-TO-TRANID four spaces, CDEMO-USER-ID eight spaces, CDEMO-USER-TYPE one space, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS one space, CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, CDEMO-CUST-MNAME and CDEMO-CUST-LNAME twenty-five spaces each, CDEMO-LAST-MAP and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET seven spaces each, and the three numeric carriers zero-filled to their pictures - CDEMO-CUST-ID 9(09), CDEMO-ACCT-ID 9(11), CDEMO-CARD-NUM 9(16). The 58-byte CDEMO-CB00-INFO extension that COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 appends inside the same 01 group - TRNID-FIRST X(16), TRNID-LAST X(16), PAGE-NUM 9(08), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X(01) VALUE 'N', TRN-SEL-FLG X(01), TRN-SELECTED X(16) - is deliberately NOT folded into those sixteen: it is this program's own extension to the shared area and stays a separate member, which is what makes the area case01 receives 218 bytes and the area here none at all. No AID is declared, because EIBAID is not read on this arm - the EVALUATE at :125-142 belongs to the re-entry side - and naming a key would imply one mattered. Nothing above is held on the server. DETERMINISM. pinnedClock is 2022-07-19T23:12:32, THE SAME INSTANT EVERY CASE IN THIS DIRECTORY PINS, and it is UNUSED HERE: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :319-338 and GET-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP at :249-267 are both unreached, so no value in this case is derived from a clock and nothing on this path is time-dependent. It is declared all the same, so that the twenty cases differ in the behaviour they pin rather than in the environment they run in, and so that no later reader can mistake an absent clock for the reason the header is absent. charset is US-ASCII, named explicitly rather than left to a platform default, which for a nine-fixture ASCII corpus and a twelve-dataset EBCDIC one is the difference between a comparison and a coincidence. UNIT KIND. The paragraph under test is MAIN-PARA, and the migration puts MAIN-PARA in BillPaymentController.payBill: this arm is implemented at BillPaymentController.mainPara :594-602 and the stamping and the transfer at returnToPrevScreen :827-844 of the same class, which is where nextProgram is set. BillPaymentService owns PROCESS-ENTER-KEY from :154 onwards and has no EIBCALEN branch at all, so a SERVICE-kind declaration would be dispatched to processEnterKey, could never reach :107-109 and could never diff to zero. CONTROLLER_POJO is therefore the kind, and it is the kind ParityCase requires a screenRequest and an expectedResponse for - which is exactly what this case is made of, since an XCTL arm writes no dataset and its whole observable behaviour is the response. It means the handler constructed through its own constructor and called as a plain Java object: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container, no JobLauncher and no application context anywhere in the path, which is what gate G51 asks for. PROVENANCE. Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:107-109 and :273-284 and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout and PICTURE clauses of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the CDEMO-CB00-INFO declaration at COBIL00C.cbl:64-72, the WS-PGMNAME and WS-TRANID literals at :37-38, and the CB00-to-COBIL00C binding at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:337-338 - and it WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it, because such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository (AAP 0.7.6 documents eight verified blockers; 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed). GATES. G15 as one of the twenty, G18 the diff-count-of-zero gate, G37 no server-side session state, G40 the XCTL-to-nextProgram projection - of which this case is this directory's primary exerciser - and G51 the plain-object invocation. NOT APPLICABLE AND DELIBERATELY NOT INVENTED: G38, because neither the ENTER nor the REENTER screen path runs here and COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA, and DFHRED appears nowhere in the program, so there is no red-and-asterisk highlight to assert anywhere in this directory; G32, no GO TO; G35, no CALL 'CEE3ABD'; G39, no pagination; and G16, G19, G21, G23, G24, G28, G45 and G47, because this arm performs no I/O and no arithmetic.
